entries.f11d57e8420d356b: A business that conducts commodity derivatives trading and financial instruments trading, consisting of entrusted business for customers and proprietary trading. In commodity derivatives trading, it handles listed commodities such as precious metals, rubber and agricultural products on Osaka Exchange, energy on Tokyo Commodity Exchange, and agricultural products on Dōjima Torihikijo. In financial instruments trading, it handles exchange index margin trading 'Yutaka CFD' and exchange foreign exchange margin trading 'Yutaka24' at Tokyo Financial Exchange, and index futures trading such as Nikkei 225 futures at Osaka Exchange. Its subsidiary Yutaka Asset Trading Kabushiki Kaisha conducts proprietary trading.
